instrument: Luzerne County Court ruling on NP Hazleton Logistics appeal (May 2026)
summary: Judge Lesa Gelb denied the developer's appeal, agreeing the project belongs before the township zoning hearing board as a special-exception application because the zoning ordinance does not address data centers.

source.citation: Times Leader; Fox 56; Center Square; Food & Water Watch; Penn Capital-Star (Nov 2025-Sept 2026)
